DIAGNOSIS READY: Osteoarthritis of the left knee.

Based on the chronic nature of your symptoms, the absence of significant morning stiffness, and the typical pattern of pain worsening with activity, this clinical picture strongly suggests osteoarthritis rather than an acute inflammatory or infectious process.
